text: A young male with a lean build, olive skin, long straight black hair falling past shoulders, and a narrow face with defined cheekbones. He wears a sleeveless red tunic. His head is turned slightly right, eyes focused forward. To his left stands an older, balding man in a reddish-brown vest over bare torso, facing him. Both appear to be conversing against a hazy blue sky with distant rocky formations and a pale sun.
